basic_details.job_title: Principal District & Sessions Judge, Munger Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Retired employees of the Civil Courts can apply for 3 contractual support staff posts in the Evening Court, Munger: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly. The Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Munger invited the applications on 7 November 2026. Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Munger on or before 30 November 2026, either personally or through registered post.

qualification.details: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only retired court employees who retired within the preceding three years, as per the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, are eligible. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must have satisfactory service records and must not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. | The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. | The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. | The applicant must be capable of performing the duties attached to the post. | The notice prints no amount. The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions are governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. The notice does not mention an age limit. The official notification does not specify a minimum educational qualification; candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: About Munger Civil Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Munger, in Bihar. It is signed by the Judge Incharge Administration, Munger, and the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Munger, on 7 November 2026. The posts are support staff for the Evening Court, Munger, and the notice has been circulated to all Judgeships of Bihar.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Munger on or before 30 November 2026. They may be submitted either personally at the office or sent through registered post. The notice prints no further postal details (such as a PIN code), no prescribed application format and no list of documents to attach. Because the notice says applications "must reach" the office by 30.11.2026, an application sent by registered post has to arrive by that date; dispatching it on the last day is not enough.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only retired court employees who retired within the preceding three years, as per the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, are eligible. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must have satisfactory service records and must not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. The applicant must be capable of performing the duties attached to the post. The notice prints no amount. The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions are governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. The notice does not mention an age limit. The official notification does not specify a minimum educational qualification; candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Munger Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts for the Evening Court, Munger: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Munger on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Munger Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the preceding three years, as per the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is required for the Stenographer post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing, besides meeting the common eligibility conditions for retired Civil Court employees.

faq.question: Q5. What is required for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the application to the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Munger, either personally or through registered post, so that it reaches by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The remuneration is governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority; the notice prints no amount.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual for the Evening Court and does not confer any right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q9. Can a retired employee with a past disciplinary penalty apply?
faq.answer: Applicants must have satisfactory service records and must not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.
